proposed_widenings.name: multi_grant_class_feature
proposed_widenings.justification: Faithful Steed grants two distinct effects at level-up time: a passive always-prepared grant and an active free-cast use-count resource. The current ClassFeatureMechanics only has a single `activation` family with one `effect` field. No existing family supports encoding two co-equal effects from a single class feature acquisition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You always have the Find Steed spell prepared. You can also cast the spell once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access (as ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The 'always prepared' mechanic adds a named spell to the paladin's always-prepared list. The v4 taxonomy has `grant_spell_access` as an effect atom but ClassFeatureEffect only has GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. A new variant is needed to encode passive permanent spell preparation grants from class features.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You always have the Find Steed spell prepared.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_free_spell_cast (as ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The free-cast mechanic allows casting a specific named spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot. This is mechanically distinct from grant_extra_action (which grants a generic action) and from heal_hp. A new ClassFeatureEffect variant is needed that carries: spellId, use_count resource, and resetCadence, with the key property that no spell slot is consumed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can also cast the spell once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

notes: The feature is a composite of two mechanically distinct grants: (1) a passive always-on spell-preparation expansion that has no activation cost or use count, and (2) an active free-cast resource gated behind a use_count=1 / long-rest reset. The current ClassFeatureMechanics surface supports only the `activation` family with a single `effect` field. Encoding this unit honestly requires either a new family (e.g., `multi_grant`) whose `effects` is an array, or a structural change allowing the activation family to carry multiple effects. Additionally, both component effects are missing from the ClassFeatureEffect union. Note: the `grant_spell_access` v4 atom exists in the taxonomy but has no corresponding surface type variant in ClassFeatureEffect.
